Evidence companion · 29 October 2026

Schumann resonance & attributed contact

Six reviewed rounds · source review + synthetic method checks

The inspected sources offer useful research connections, but they do not demonstrate a Schumann–ET contact mechanism. This companion connects the channeling corpus to the Energy Observatory’s physical models, evidence map and prospective protocol.

Four specialist model-agent panelists and two implementation/verification workers contributed. No new station measurement, human session or contact attempt was conducted.

What the six rounds established

01

Source and novelty audit

Historical assertions, measured geophysics and attributed communications require different evidence. The current contribution is replication and evidence engineering.

02

Ideal magnetic receiver

Dimensioned Faraday and resistor-noise calculations passed independent checks. An ideal voltage does not establish actual detectability, biological response or source identity.

03

Selected-lag bias

An exact synthetic example exposed an invalid lag-selection procedure—and a resolution limit that made the corrected 32-phase test unable to reject at 5%.

04

Resolution and cause

A separately versioned 256-phase example resolved that limit. A shared-driver example showed why identical observations can still fit distinct causal models.

05

Information and leakage

Ordinary information leakage can produce the same hit-count distribution as a proposed exotic mechanism. Two contamination models require different bounds.

06

Evidence intake

Metadata readiness remains separate from authentication. A fully fabricated packet can pass structural checks while establishing no empirical result or contact.

All executed numerical experiments were synthetic. The original 32-phase limitation and the repaired probability-underflow failure remain in the study’s versioned records.

Documentary correction

Attribute frequency claims to the actual source

The older blanket statement that Bashar material specifies no frequencies needs correction. The official Circle of Self Empowerment handout includes a 3–8 Hz theta band on PDF page 3. A participant-published transcript marked as authorized attributes 40–100 cycles/s gamma language on PDF page 1.

These are documented assertions. Their presence does not validate the physiological, ionospheric or source claims. The transcript was not independently matched to original audio. Third-party 7.85 Hz attributions remain unverified leads.

A connection is not a mechanism

Shared frequency labels, symbols, calendar encodings or vocabulary do not supply a measured coupling law. Occult texts can be studied as historical sources; their attributed speakers are not thereby identified as extraterrestrial communicators.

Astronomy tools can provide declared timing and geometry covariates. Symbolic interpretations need their own locked, held-out predictions.

Current evidence state

The paired measurement is still missing

The reviewed quick-look images, geomagnetic Kp records and channeling texts do not form a calibrated, synchronized Schumann/contact dataset. Kp is a different observable. Recent Schumann anomaly claims remain unresolved by this packet.

The next useful step is one bounded, licensed environmental packet with calibration, noise and quality records, followed by an independently reviewed concealed-information protocol if that question is pursued.

Before any empirical inference

  • Lock original event times; upload and repost dates are not substitutes.
  • Retain all attempts, misses and abstentions; audit target custody and information leakage.
  • Fix the lag/search family, calendar controls, null assumptions and held-out evaluation.
  • Keep environmental association, information accuracy and sender attribution separate.
